title: Padding commutes with an action
statement: Let $k,K\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state set, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $a$ be an action on $k$ work tapes and $c$ a configuration on those tapes over input $x$. Applying the action padded to $K$ tapes to the padded configuration gives exactly the padding of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on $k$ work tapes over input $x$
replaced: For every action and configuration on the source tapes, applying the padded action to the padded configuration equals padding the result of the original application, including writes at arbitrary cells; inactive slots neither write nor move.
